features.name: Armor Proficiency
features.description:
A viking is not proficient with heavy armor.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Fearsome
features.description:
At 2nd level, a viking can make an Intimidate check to demoralize an opponent as a [move action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#move). At 10th level, she can do so as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift). At 18th level, she can demoralize a foe as a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free) once per round.

This ability replaces a warrior talent gained at 2nd level.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Shield Defense
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, a viking learns the art of fighting with a shield. Whenever she is wearing medium, light, or no armor and wielding a shield, the viking’s shield bonus to AC increases by 1. Every four warrior levels thereafter (7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th), this bonus increases by 1.

This ability replaces overhand chop and increase save from warrior techniques.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Berserker
features.description:
At 4th level, a viking gains the [rage](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/classes/base-classes/berserker/#rage) and [rage forms](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/classes/base-classes/berserker/#rage-forms) abilities as the berserker class feature, but her berserker level is considered to be her warrior level –3.

This ability replaces physical resilience.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Rage Powers
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, whenever a viking gains a warrior talent or advanced talent, she can instead choose to gain a single [rage power](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/classes/base-classes/berserker/rage-powers/), as the berserker class feature, in place of it. Once selected, these rage powers cannot be changed. Her berserker level is considered to be her warrior level –3 for these rage powers.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.
